result.title: See, Think, Use: Diagnosing Perception and Reasoning Failures in VLMs
result.summary: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the measured stages comes close to the best uniform policy at lower cost and beats a random allocation of the same compute wherever a knob raises the short stage. We will release the code, the prompts and the per-question outputs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「See、Think、Use」诊断协议：用定位探针测感知、文本替换探针测推理，并以反事实图像对上的无标签「Use」率衡量答案是否真正依据模型自身感知，进而把测试时算力导向失败阶段。
AI.relevance_reason: 与「答案是否使用视觉证据」及 THINK/LOOK 的收益成本直接相关：反事实对上的 Use 率可能成为视觉旁路与信息坍缩的度量，按阶段分配算力亦可供核查计算分配与停止策略。
